compiled_rule.technosphere_information_loss: Only the enumerated exact ecoinvent 3.9 cut-off source profiles qualify. Cable has positive kg reference; waste markets have negative kg reference and target positive one-kg treatment service. Preserve signed caller quantities, supported uncertainty/formulas, foreground ownership and separately listed emissions. No inverse, other source profile or cross-system-model route is inferred. Source material/fabrication, factory water/releases, rolling infrastructure, waste/country shares and collection/final freight remain at their original quantities. Negative inputs to negative waste references become positive treatment demand, not avoided-treatment credits. Retain market share uncertainty and all supported sign scaling, without normalization or a new loss/recovery credit. Do not replace those routes with Swiss controlled disposal or an empty stock. Controlled municipal-incineration/sanitary-landfill fractions use complete native CH services for the same 15.3%-water mixed-plastic wet-kg waste. The source controlled processes share the reference-flow UUID, wet/dry mass, water-in-wet-mass and net-heating-value basis. The fly-ash-extraction reference has more elemental metadata, a slightly different carbon fraction/allocation and rounded water-content ratio; these differences are recorded, not rescaled away. Preserve every original tkm, including Chinese generic rail through generic RER rail rather than coal freight. At source 0.33840125 kg HDPE/kg cable, their combined quantity is about 3.97e-14 kg/kg cable. Preserve every literal omission entry in the audit, do not replace them with empty recycling/virgin supply, and do not renormalize retained virgin shares or freight. No new source input omission is approved here.
